flow_scope: Hash-verified recovered raw results with an accepted mesh; request-level descriptive counts, including repeated geometries. Valid means all per-condition acceptance gates, not merely numerical convergence.
source_mesh_scope: Descriptive combined counts from two separately frozen source cohorts. Mesh acceptance only; not exact mesh or CFD score reproduction. The additional cohort was chosen after first-cohort results were known. No pooled confidence interval is claimed.
failed_mesh_scope: Complete census of all 1913 distinct failed geometries recoverable from released request categories or raw evaluation records (all 30 prespecified batches). One additional mesh-failure request lacks an archived geometry and cannot be rerun. This is not an unconditional failure-rate sample of arbitrary wings.
failed_mesh_order_algorithm: Python random.Random(int(seed_hex,16)).shuffle of case_id-sorted full population, drawn once independently of outcomes
failed_mesh_reporting_rule: Report complete prespecified batches from the start of this order; retain every selected case including unsuccessful and timed-out meshes. Incomplete jobs are missing, never excluded. Existing matching results may be reused for selected cases. The earlier diagnostic panel stays separately identified. Stop requests halt future batches; complete the current batch before reporting its outcomes. Outcome-dependent stopping must be disclosed; ordinary fixed-sample confidence intervals are not automatically valid under optional stopping.
agent_handoff_scope: All 360 first-four-query handoffs in 90 episodes, plus q5-q8 in two selected open-ended examples; rationales are agent statements, not independently verified diagnoses.
recovery_scope: Successful bounded-recovery outcomes from the archived audit; retains every episode in the main results.
